qComment: The Latest Date: the last Date with Sales in the current selection. Every window ends on it.
Last day of YTD and Rolling 12 Months: the Latest Date, as a day number.
Last day of the Prior Year windows: the Latest Date one year earlier (29 February becomes 28 February).
First day of YTD: 1 January of the Latest Date's year.
First day of YTD Prior Year: 1 January of the year before.
First day of Rolling 12 Months: the day after the Latest Date one year earlier.
First day of Rolling 12 Months Prior Year: the day after the Latest Date two years earlier.
Set modifier for the days $1 to $2 (day numbers): replaces any selection in the calendar fields and keeps all other selections. Use as {<$(vDays(first, last))>}.
Set modifier for YTD: Sum({<$(vYTD)>} Sales).
Set modifier for YTD Prior Year.
Set modifier for Rolling 12 Months.
Set modifier for Rolling 12 Months Prior Year.

qDefinition: Sum({<Year=, Quarter=, Month=, [Year Month]=, Date={">=$(=Date(MonthStart($1)))<=$(=Date($2))"}>} Budget * (RangeMin(Floor(MonthEnd(Date)), $2) - RangeMax(Date, $1) + 1) / Day(MonthEnd(Date)))
qComment: Budget for the days $1 to $2 (day numbers): each month's Budget spread evenly over its days, so a window that starts or ends mid-month gets that share of the month. Use as $(vBudget($(vYTDFirstDay), $(vLastDay))).

qDefinition: (Count(DISTINCT Customer) = Count({<Customer=>} DISTINCT Customer) and Count(DISTINCT [Production Site]) = Count({<[Production Site]=>} DISTINCT [Production Site]))
qComment: True unless the selection narrows Customer or Production Site, levels Budget is not planned at. Every Budget measure is null when it is false: If($(vBudgetDefined), ...).

qDefinition: (If(Sum({<$(vYTDPriorYear)>} Volume) > 0, (Sum({<$(vYTD)>} Volume) - Sum({<$(vYTDPriorYear)>} Volume)) * Sum({<$(vYTDPriorYear)>} Sales) / Sum({<$(vYTDPriorYear)>} Volume), Sum({<$(vYTD)>} Sales) - Sum({<$(vYTDPriorYear)>} Sales)))
qComment: Volume Effect of Sales YTD against YTD Prior Year in EUR: the change in Volume at the Prior Year average price (all of the change when there is no Prior Year Volume). See docs/measures.md, Sales Bridge.

qDefinition: Sum({<$(vYTD)>} Aggr({<$(vYTD)>} If(Sum({<$(vYTDPriorYear)>} Volume) > 0, Sum({<$(vYTD)>} Sales) - Sum({<$(vYTD)>} Volume) * Sum({<$(vYTDPriorYear)>} Sales) / Sum({<$(vYTDPriorYear)>} Volume)), [Product Line ID], [Customer ID]))
qComment: Price Effect of Sales YTD against YTD Prior Year in EUR: for each Product Line by Customer with Volume in both windows, YTD Volume times the change in its price. See docs/measures.md, Sales Bridge.
What-If price change in percent (5 = net prices 5% higher, volume and cost unchanged). Set by the What-If Controls.
What-If volume change in percent (5 = 5% more units at the same prices and unit cost). Set by the What-If Controls.
What-If EUR exchange rate change in percent (5 = the euro buys 5% more of every other currency, so amounts in them are worth 1/1.05 in EUR). Set by the What-If Controls.

What-If exchange rate assumption: the Countries that invoice in EUR; Sales to every other Country is in its local currency. Used as a set element list (Country -= {$(vEuroArea)}) and shown on the Sheet, so the names carry no quotes; a name with a space would need them.
What-If exchange rate assumption: the share of the cost of Sales outside the euro area that is in local currency; the rest is bought in EUR.
Simulated Sales YTD in EUR: Sales YTD at the What-If price and volume, with Sales outside the euro area translated at the What-If exchange rate.
Simulated cost YTD in EUR: cost YTD at the What-If volume (a price change leaves it unchanged), with the local share of cost outside the euro area translated at the What-If exchange rate.
